transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’ve started to feel like I’m just not good enough at anything anymore, no matter how hard I try. My husband actually encouraged me to come in and talk to you after we had a really emotional conversation about it recently.
Have you felt this way for a long time—perhaps for several years—or is this a newer experience that started within the last few months?

It’s actually been going on for quite a while now, a little over two years. It really started around the time my husband and I began fertility treatments, and this heavy feeling has just been there pretty much continuously since then.

During these past two years, have there been any periods of a few weeks or months where your mood felt significantly worse, perhaps with a complete loss of interest in everything, or has the intensity of these feelings remained relatively constant?

It has been relatively constant, without any major spikes or deep dips. It just feels like a continuous, heavy, low-grade sadness in my chest that never really lifts. I’ve just been dragging myself through this same constant feeling for the last two years.
Over these past two years, have you consistently experienced physical symptoms like changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or energy levels?

Yes, my energy levels have been completely drained for the past two years. No matter how much sleep I get, I have to force myself just to get through the school day, and then I collapse on the couch at home because even simple chores feel like too much effort.

Besides your low energy, have you also noticed consistent changes in your appetite or sleep patterns—such as eating significantly more or less, or having trouble falling or staying asleep—over these past two years?

I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite. As for my sleep, I don't have trouble falling or staying asleep and actually get plenty of hours, but I just always wake up feeling tired anyway.
Beyond feeling low and tired, have you also been struggling with feelings of hopelessness, poor concentration, or low self-esteem during these past two years?

Yes, I struggle deeply with both. I have this constant running commentary in my head telling me I’m a bad wife for not getting pregnant and a mediocre teacher, and I honestly can't picture the future getting any better. While I can still concentrate enough to get my teaching and planning done, it's this overwhelming self-doubt and feeling of being stuck in a loop that truly weighs me down.

During these two years, have you ever experienced a period of at least two consecutive months where you felt completely symptom-free, or has the low mood been present nearly every day without such a break?

No, I haven't had any breaks where I felt normal for two months, or even a few weeks. This heavy, low mood has been present pretty much continuously, day in and day out, for the entire two-year period since we started the fertility treatments.
